<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: right; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><B>Exhibit 10.9</B></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><B>FEDEX FREIGHT HOLDING COMPANY,&nbsp;INC.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><B>2026 OMNIBUS STOCK INCENTIVE PLAN</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>Section&nbsp;1. Purpose</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">The purpose of the FedEx Freight Holding Company,&nbsp;Inc. 2026 Omnibus
Stock Incentive Plan, as amended from time to time (the &ldquo;<B>Plan</B>&rdquo;), is to aid the Company and its Affiliates in retaining,
attracting, and rewarding Non-Management Directors and designated employees and to motivate them to exert their best efforts to achieve
the long-term goals of the Company and its Affiliates. The Company believes that the ownership or increased ownership of Common Stock
by employees and directors, or otherwise linking the compensation of employees and directors to the value of Common Stock, will further
align their interests with those of the Company&rsquo;s other stockholders and will promote the long-term success of the Company and
the creation of long-term stockholder value. Accordingly, the Plan authorizes the grant of equity incentive and other awards to designated
employees of the Company and its Affiliates and to directors of the Company.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>Section&nbsp;2. Definitions and Rules&nbsp;of Construction</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">2.1</TD><TD><U>Definitions</U>.&emsp;The following capitalized terms used in the Plan
                                            shall have the respective meanings set forth below:</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Affiliate</B>&rdquo; means (a)&nbsp;any Subsidiary
and (b)&nbsp;any other entity that, directly or through one or more intermediaries, is controlled by the Company, as determined by the
Committee.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Award</B>&rdquo; means any Stock Option, Stock
Appreciation Right, Restricted Share, Restricted Stock Unit, Dividend Equivalent, Other Stock-Based Award, or Cash Award, together with
any related right or interest, granted to a Participant under the Plan.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Award Agreement</B>&rdquo; means a written or
electronic agreement between the Company and a Participant setting forth the terms, conditions, restrictions, and other provisions of
an Award granted to the Participant.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Board of Directors</B>&rdquo; means the Board
of Directors of the Company.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Cash Award</B>&rdquo; means an Award granted to
a Participant under <U>Section&nbsp;15</U>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Change of Control</B>&rdquo; has the meaning given
such term in <U>Section&nbsp;21.1</U>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Code</B>&rdquo; means the Internal Revenue Code
of 1986, as amended.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Committee</B>&rdquo; means those members, not
less than two, of the Human Resources and Compensation Committee of the Board of Directors who are Independent Directors, or any successor
committee or subcommittee of the Board of Directors designated by the Board of Directors, which committee or subcommittee shall be comprised
of two or more members of the Board of Directors, each of whom is an Independent Director, subject to <U>Section&nbsp;4.1</U>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Common Stock</B>&rdquo; means the common stock,
par value $0.10 per share, of the Company and such other securities of the Company as may be substituted for Common Stock pursuant to
<U>Section&nbsp;20.1</U> or <U>20.2</U>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Company</B>&rdquo; means FedEx Freight Holding
Company,&nbsp;Inc., a Delaware corporation (or any successor company, except as the term &ldquo;<B>Company</B>&rdquo; is used in the
definition of &ldquo;Change of Control&rdquo;).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Conversion Award</B>&rdquo; has the meaning given
such term in <U>Section&nbsp;16</U>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Disability</B>&rdquo; means &ldquo;permanent disability&rdquo;
as determined by the Committee in its sole discretion.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Dividend Equivalent</B>&rdquo; means the right
granted to a Participant under <U>Section&nbsp;13</U> to receive a payment in an amount equal to the dividends paid on one outstanding
Share with respect to all or a portion of the Shares subject to a Full-Value Award held by such Participant.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Effective Date</B>&rdquo; means&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;
, 2026.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Eligible Person</B>&rdquo; means (a)&nbsp;any
employee of the Company or an Affiliate, (b)&nbsp;any individual to whom an offer of employment with the Company or an Affiliate is made,
as determined by the Committee (provided that such prospective employee may not receive any payment or exercise any right with respect
to an Award until such person has commenced such employment), (c)&nbsp;any Non-Management Director, and (d)&nbsp;any non-employee service
provider of the Company or an Affiliate.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Exchange Act</B>&rdquo; means the Securities Exchange
Act of 1934, as amended.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Exercise Price</B>&rdquo; means (a)&nbsp;in the
case of a Stock Option, the amount for which a Share may be purchased upon exercise of such Stock Option, as set forth in the applicable
Award Agreement, and (b)&nbsp;in the case of a Stock Appreciation Right, the per Share amount, as specified in the applicable Award Agreement,
which is subtracted from the Fair Market Value of a Share in determining the amount payable upon exercise of such SAR.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Fair Market Value</B>&rdquo; of a Share or other
security as of a particular date means the fair market value as determined by the Committee in its sole discretion; <U>provided</U>,
<U>however</U>, that except as otherwise determined by the Committee<FONT STYLE="color: #595959">, </FONT>(i)&nbsp;if Shares or other
securities are admitted to trading on a national securities exchange, the fair market value on any date shall be the closing sale price
for a Share or such other security as reported on such date, or if no Shares or other securities were traded on such date, on the last
preceding date for which there was a sale of a Share or other security on such exchange, or (ii)&nbsp;if Shares or other securities are
then traded on an over-the-counter market, the fair market value on any date shall be the average of the closing bid and asked prices
for a Share or such other security in such over-the-counter market for the last preceding date on which there was a sale of such Share
or other security in such market.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>FedEx</B>&rdquo; means FedEx Corporation, a Delaware
corporation.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Full-Value Award</B>&rdquo; means any Award other
than in the form of a Stock Option or Stock Appreciation Right and which is settled by the issuance of Shares (or at the discretion of
the Committee, settled in cash or other consideration by reference to the value of Shares).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Grant Date</B>&rdquo; means the date on which
the Committee completes the corporate action authorizing the grant of an Award or such later date as is determined and specified by the
Committee as part of that authorization process.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Incentive Stock Option</B>&rdquo; or &ldquo;<B>ISO</B>&rdquo;
means a Stock Option or portion thereof that is intended to be and specifically designated as an &ldquo;incentive stock option&rdquo;
within the meaning of Code Section&nbsp;422 and meets the requirements thereof.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Independent Director</B>&rdquo; means a member
of the Board of Directors who qualifies at any given time as (a)&nbsp;an &ldquo;independent director&rdquo; under Section&nbsp;303A of
the New York Stock Exchange Listed Company Manual and (b)&nbsp;a &ldquo;non-employee director&rdquo; as defined in Rule&nbsp;16b-3.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Net Exercise</B>&rdquo; means a Participant&rsquo;s
ability (if authorized by the Committee) to exercise a Stock Option by directing the Company to deduct from the Shares issuable upon
exercise of his or her Stock Option a number of Shares having an aggregate Fair Market Value equal to the sum of the aggregate Exercise
Price therefor plus the amount of the Participant&rsquo;s tax withholding (if any), whereupon the Company shall issue to the Participant
the net remaining number of Shares after such deduction.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Non-Management Director</B>&rdquo; means a member
of the Board of Directors who is not an employee of the Company or an Affiliate.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Non-Qualified Stock Option</B>&rdquo; or &ldquo;<B>NQSO</B>&rdquo;
means a Stock Option or portion thereof that is not an Incentive Stock Option.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Other Stock-Based Award</B>&rdquo; means an Award
granted to a Participant under <U>Section&nbsp;14</U>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Participant</B>&rdquo; means any Eligible Person
who receives an Award under the Plan.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Performance Award</B>&rdquo; means an Award that
includes performance conditions as specified by the Committee pursuant to <U>Section&nbsp;12</U>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Performance Period</B>&rdquo; means the period
of service to which the performance goal or goals for a Performance Award relate as determined by the Committee in its sole discretion.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Plan</B>&rdquo; has the meaning given such term
in <U>Section&nbsp;1</U>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Reporting Person</B>&rdquo; means (a)&nbsp;a Non-Management
Director and (b)&nbsp;an employee of the Company or an Affiliate who is subject to the reporting requirements of Section&nbsp;16(a)&nbsp;of
the Exchange Act.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Restricted Shares</B>&rdquo; means Shares granted
to a Participant under <U>Section&nbsp;10</U> that are subject to certain restrictions and conditions and to a risk of forfeiture.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Restricted Stock Unit</B>&rdquo; or &ldquo;<B>RSU</B>&rdquo;
means the right to acquire one Share, or receive the equivalent amount in cash, granted to a Participant under <U>Section&nbsp;11</U>,
which right is subject to certain restrictions and conditions and to a risk of forfeiture.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Retirement</B>&rdquo; has the meaning given such
term in <U>Section&nbsp;19.3</U>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Rule&nbsp;16b-3</B>&rdquo; means Rule&nbsp;16b-3
under the Exchange Act.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Securities Act</B>&rdquo; means the Securities
Act of 1933, as amended.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Separation</B>&rdquo; means the consummation of
the transactions contemplated by the Separation and Distribution Agreement, dated as of&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; , 2026, by and between FedEx and the Company
resulting in the Company becoming a publicly listed company.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Service</B>&rdquo; means a Participant&rsquo;s
employment with the Company or an Affiliate or a Participant&rsquo;s service as a Non-Management Director or non-employee service provider
of the Company or an Affiliate, as applicable.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Shares</B>&rdquo; means shares of Common Stock.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Stock Appreciation Right</B>&rdquo; or &ldquo;<B>SAR</B>&rdquo;
means a right granted to a Participant under <U>Section&nbsp;9</U> to receive a payment equal to the excess of the Fair Market Value
of a Share as of the date of exercise of the SAR over the Exercise Price of the SAR.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Stock Option</B>&rdquo; means a right granted
to a Participant under <U>Section&nbsp;8</U> to purchase a specified number of Shares at a specified price during a specified time period.
A Stock Option may be an Incentive Stock Option or a Non-Qualified Stock Option.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Subsidiary</B>&rdquo; means any corporation or
other entity of which the Company possesses, directly or through one or more intermediaries, 50% or more of the total combined voting
power of such entity.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Substitute Awards</B>&rdquo; means Awards granted
under <U>Section&nbsp;7.6</U> in assumption of, or in substitution for, outstanding awards previously granted by a company or business
acquired by the Company or an Affiliate.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">2.2</TD><TD><U>Rules&nbsp;of Construction</U>.&emsp;The section and other headings
                                            contained in the Plan are for reference purposes only and shall not affect the meaning or
                                            interpretation of the Plan. Unless the context clearly requires otherwise: (a)&nbsp;references
                                            to the plural include the singular and to the singular include the plural; (b)&nbsp;the terms
                                            &ldquo;includes&rdquo; and &ldquo;including&rdquo; are not limiting; (c)&nbsp;the term &ldquo;or&rdquo;
                                            has the inclusive meaning represented by the phrase &ldquo;and/or&rdquo;; (d)&nbsp;any grammatical
                                            form or variant of a term defined in the Plan shall be construed to have a meaning corresponding
                                            to the definition of the term set forth herein; and (e)&nbsp;references to any provision
                                            of a statute shall be deemed to include references to any applicable rules&nbsp;and regulations
                                            promulgated thereunder, including proposed rules&nbsp;and regulations, and other guidance
                                            issued thereto, by an applicable governmental entity, and any successor provisions, rules&nbsp;and
                                            regulations. The terms &ldquo;hereof,&rdquo; &ldquo;hereto,&rdquo; &ldquo;hereunder,&rdquo;
                                            and similar terms in the Plan refer to the Plan as a whole and not to any particular provision
                                            of the Plan.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>Section&nbsp;3. Term of the Plan</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">3.1</TD><TD><U>Effective Date</U>.&emsp;The Plan shall be effective as of the Effective
                                            Date, <U>provided</U> that the Plan shall have been adopted by the Board and approved by
                                            the Company&rsquo;s sole stockholder in accordance with the General Corporation Law of the
                                            State of Delaware and the rules&nbsp;of the New York Stock Exchange.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">3.2</TD><TD><U>Term of the Plan</U>.&emsp;Unless the Plan is earlier terminated in
                                            accordance with the provisions hereof, no Award shall be granted under the Plan on or after
                                            the tenth anniversary of the Effective Date, but Awards granted prior to such date shall
                                            continue to be governed by the terms and conditions of the Plan and the applicable Award
                                            Agreement (including terms regarding amendments to or modifications of outstanding Awards).

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>
</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>Section&nbsp;4. Administration of the Plan</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">4.1</TD><TD><U>The Committee</U>.&emsp;The Plan shall be administered by the Committee.
                                            No action of the Committee under the Plan shall be void or deemed to be without authority
                                            due to a Committee member&rsquo;s failure to qualify as an Independent Director at the time
                                            the action was taken.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">4.2</TD><TD><U>Committee Authority</U>.&emsp;Subject to the express provisions of
                                            the Plan, the Committee shall have full and exclusive power, authority, and discretion to
                                            take any and all actions necessary, appropriate, or advisable for the administration of the
                                            Plan, including the following:</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(a)</TD><TD>Select Eligible Persons to become Participants;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(b)</TD><TD>Grant Awards;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

                                            conditions of any outstanding Award;</TD></TR></TABLE>

                                            of or to accommodate the tax policy or custom of, foreign jurisdictions;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(k)</TD><TD>Establish, adopt, or revise rules, guidelines, and policies for the
                                            administration of the Plan;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(l)</TD><TD>Construe and interpret the Plan, any Award Agreement, and any other
                                            documents and instruments relating to the Plan or any Award;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(m)</TD><TD>Correct any defect, supply any omission, or reconcile any inconsistency
                                            in the Plan or any Award Agreement; and</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(n)</TD><TD>Make all other decisions and determinations and take such other actions
                                            with respect to the Plan or any Award as the Committee may deem necessary, appropriate, or
                                            advisable for the administration of the Plan.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">The express grant of any specific power to the Committee,
and the taking of any action by the Committee, shall not be construed as limiting any power or authority of the Committee.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">4.3</TD><TD><U>Grants to Non-Management Directors</U>.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(a)</TD><TD><I>Awards</I>.&emsp;Notwithstanding any other provision of the Plan,
                                            including <U>Sections&nbsp;4.1</U> and <U>4.2</U>, any Awards made under the Plan to Non-Management
                                            Directors shall be approved, or made in accordance with a policy or program approved, by
                                            the Board of Directors; <U>provided</U>, <U>however</U>, (1)&nbsp;the Committee shall recommend
                                            such Awards, policy or program to the Board of Directors for its approval and (2)&nbsp;the
                                            Committee retains full independent authority conferred under the Plan with respect to all
                                            other aspects of Awards to Non-Management Directors. Solely with respect to the grant of
                                            Awards to Non-Management Directors, all rights, powers, and authorities vested in the Committee
                                            under the Plan with respect thereto shall instead be exercised by the Board of Directors
                                            and any reference in the Plan to the Committee shall be deemed to include a reference to
                                            the Board of Directors.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(b)</TD><TD><I>Retainers</I>.&emsp;Upon such terms and conditions as may be established
                                            by the Board of Directors, each Non-Management Director may elect to have all or part of
                                            his or her retainer paid in Shares under the Plan.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(c)</TD><TD><I>Limit on Non-Management Director Compensation.</I>&emsp;The maximum
                                            aggregate amount that may be paid to any one Non-Management Director in any one of the Company&rsquo;s
                                            fiscal&nbsp;years, in cash, Awards, or otherwise, as applicable, is $2,000,000. In the case
                                            of any Awards, the value thereof shall be based on the Grant Date fair value as determined
                                            for accounting purposes.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">4.4</TD><TD><U>Actions and Interpretations by the Committee</U>.&emsp;All interpretations,
                                            decisions, determinations, and actions under or with respect to the Plan shall be within
                                            the sole discretion of the Committee, may be made at any time, and shall be final, conclusive,
                                            and binding on all persons, including Participants, persons claiming rights from or through
                                            a Participant, and stockholders. The Committee&rsquo;s determinations under the Plan need
                                            not be uniform and may be made selectively among Participants, whether or not such Participants
                                            are similarly situated.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">4.5</TD><TD><U>Delegation of Authority</U>.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(a)</TD><TD>Subject to any applicable laws, rules, or regulations (including Section&nbsp;157(c)&nbsp;of
                                            the Delaware General Corporation Law or any successor provision), the Committee may, by resolution,
                                            expressly delegate to one or more officers of the Company the authority, within specified
                                            parameters as to the number, types, and terms of Awards, to (1)&nbsp;designate Eligible Persons
                                            to be recipients of Awards and (2)&nbsp;determine the number of such Awards to be received
                                            by any such Participants; <U>provided</U>, <U>however</U>, that such delegation may not be
                                            made with respect to Awards to be granted to any Reporting Person.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(b)</TD><TD>The Committee may delegate to any appropriate officer or employee
                                            of the Company or an Affiliate responsibility for performing ministerial and administrative
                                            functions under the Plan.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(c)</TD><TD>In the event that the Committee&rsquo;s authority is delegated to
                                            any officer or employee in accordance with <U>Section&nbsp;4.5(a)</U>&nbsp;or <U>(b)</U>,
                                            any actions undertaken by such person in accordance with the Committee&rsquo;s delegation
                                            of authority shall have the same force and effect as if undertaken directly by the Committee,
                                            and any reference in the Plan to the Committee shall, to the extent consistent with the terms
                                            and limitations of such delegation, be deemed to include a reference to such officer or employee.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">4.6</TD><TD><U>Limitation of Liability</U>.&emsp;The Committee and each member thereof
                                            shall be entitled to, in good faith, rely or act upon any report or other information furnished
                                            by any officer or employee of the Company or an Affiliate, the Company&rsquo;s independent
                                            certified public accountants, counsel, or other advisors, or any consultant, attorney, accountant,
                                            or other advisor retained by the Committee to assist in the administration of the Plan. Neither
                                            the Board of Directors nor the Committee, nor any member of either, shall be liable for any
                                            act, omission, interpretation, decision, construction, or determination made in good faith
                                            in connection with the Plan or any Award.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>Section&nbsp;5. Shares Subject to the Plan; Maximum Awards</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">5.1</TD><TD><U>Number of Shares</U>.&emsp;Subject to the Share counting rules&nbsp;set
                                            forth in <U>Section&nbsp;5.3</U> and to adjustment as provided in <U>Section&nbsp;20</U>,
                                            the aggregate maximum number of Shares reserved and available for issuance pursuant to Awards
                                            granted under the Plan shall be Shares.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">5.2</TD><TD><U>Incentive Stock Options</U>.&emsp;The maximum number of Shares that
                                            may be issued upon exercise of Incentive Stock Options granted under the Plan shall be Shares,
                                            subject to adjustment as provided in <U>Section&nbsp;20</U>.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">5.3</TD><TD><U>Share Counting</U>.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(a)</TD><TD>The number of Shares covered by an Award, or to which an Award relates,
                                            shall be subtracted from the Plan&nbsp;Share reserve as of the Grant Date.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(b)</TD><TD>To the extent an Award is canceled, terminates, expires, is forfeited,
                                            or lapses for any reason (in whole or in part), any unissued or forfeited Shares subject
                                            to the Award shall be added back to the Plan&nbsp;Share reserve and available again for issuance
                                            pursuant to Awards granted under the Plan.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(c)</TD><TD>Any Shares related to an Award that is settled in cash or other consideration
                                            in lieu of Shares shall be added back to the Plan&nbsp;Share reserve and available again
                                            for issuance pursuant to Awards granted under the Plan.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(d)</TD><TD>Shares withheld or deducted from an Award by the Company to satisfy
                                            tax withholding requirements relating to Stock Options or Stock Appreciation Rights shall
                                            not be added back to the Plan&nbsp;Share reserve and shall not again be available for issuance
                                            pursuant to Awards granted under the Plan, but Shares withheld or deducted by the Company
                                            to satisfy tax withholding requirements relating to Full-Value Awards shall be added back
                                            to the Plan&nbsp;Share reserve and available again for issuance pursuant to Awards granted
                                            under the Plan. Shares delivered by a Participant to the Company to satisfy tax withholding
                                            requirements shall be treated in the same way as Shares withheld or deducted from an Award
                                            as specified above for purposes of Share counting under this <U>Section&nbsp;5.3(d)</U>.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(e)</TD><TD>To the extent that the full number of Shares subject to a Stock Option
                                            or a Share-settled Stock Appreciation Right is not issued upon exercise of such Stock Option
                                            or Stock Appreciation Right for any reason, including by reason of a net settlement or Net
                                            Exercise, then all Shares that were covered by the exercised Stock Option or SAR shall not
                                            be added back to the Plan&nbsp;Share reserve and shall not again be available for issuance
                                            pursuant to Awards granted under the Plan.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(f)</TD><TD>If the Exercise Price of a Stock Option is satisfied by delivering
                                            Shares to the Company (by either actual delivery or attestation), such Shares shall not be
                                            added to the Plan&nbsp;Share reserve and shall not be available for issuance pursuant to
                                            Awards granted under the Plan.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(g)</TD><TD>To the extent that the full number of Shares subject to a Performance
                                            Award (other than a Stock Option or Stock Appreciation Right) is not issued by reason of
                                            failure to achieve maximum performance goals, the number of Shares not issued shall be added
                                            back to the Plan&nbsp;Share reserve and shall be available again for issuance pursuant to
                                            Awards granted under the Plan.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(h)</TD><TD>Shares repurchased on the open market with the proceeds of a Stock
                                            Option exercise shall not be added to the Plan&nbsp;Share reserve and shall not be available
                                            for issuance pursuant to Awards granted under the Plan.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(i)</TD><TD>Any Dividend Equivalent denominated in Shares shall be counted against
                                            the aggregate number of Shares available for issuance pursuant to Awards under the Plan in
                                            such amount and at such time as the Dividend Equivalent first constitutes a commitment to
                                            issue Shares.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(j)</TD><TD>Substitute Awards granted pursuant to <U>Section&nbsp;7.6</U> shall
                                            not count against the Plan&nbsp;Share reserve and the Shares otherwise available for issuance
                                            under the Plan.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">5.4</TD><TD><U>Source of Shares</U>.&emsp;Shares issued under the Plan may consist,
                                            in whole or in part, of authorized but unissued shares or treasury shares.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">5.5</TD><TD><U>Fractional Shares</U>.&emsp;No fractional Shares shall be issued under
                                            or pursuant to the Plan or any Award and the Committee shall determine, in its sole discretion,
                                            whether cash shall be given in lieu of fractional Shares or whether such fractional Shares
                                            shall be eliminated by rounding up or down.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>Section&nbsp;6. Eligibility and Participation in the Plan; Limitation
on Rights of Participants</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">6.1</TD><TD><U>Eligible Persons</U>.&emsp;Only Eligible Persons are eligible to be
                                            designated by the Committee to receive Awards and become Participants under the Plan.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">6.2</TD><TD><U>Participation in the Plan</U>.&emsp;The Committee shall from time to
                                            time, in its sole and complete discretion and subject to the provisions of the Plan, designate
                                            those Eligible Persons to whom Awards shall be granted and shall determine the nature and
                                            amount of each Award.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">6.3</TD><TD><U>No Right to Receive Award or Be Treated Uniformly</U>.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(a)</TD><TD>No Eligible Person or other person shall have any claim or right to
                                            receive an Award under the Plan, and no Participant, having received an Award, shall have
                                            any claim or right to receive a future Award.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(b)</TD><TD>Neither the Company, its Affiliates, nor the Committee has any obligation
                                            to treat Eligible Persons or Participants uniformly under the Plan. Determinations made under
                                            the Plan may be made by the Committee selectively among Eligible Persons and Participants,
                                            whether or not such persons are similarly situated.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(c)</TD><TD>The grant of an Award under the Plan shall not confer any rights upon
                                            the Participant holding such Award other than such terms, and subject to such conditions,
                                            as are specified in the Plan as being applicable to such type of Award or to all Awards or
                                            as are expressly set forth in the Award Agreement relating to such Award.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">6.4</TD><TD><U>No Right to Employment or Service</U>.&emsp;Neither the Plan, any Award
                                            granted under the Plan, nor any Award Agreement (a)&nbsp;shall be deemed to constitute an
                                            employment contract or confer or be deemed to confer upon any Eligible Person or Participant
                                            any right to remain employed by the Company or an Affiliate, as the case may be, or to continue
                                            to provide services as a Non-Management Director or as a non-employee service provider, or
                                            (b)&nbsp;interfere with or limit in any way the right of the Company or an Affiliate, as
                                            the case may be, to terminate an Eligible Person&rsquo;s or Participant&rsquo;s employment
                                            with the Company or an Affiliate or service as a Non-Management Director or as a non-employee
                                            service provider for any reason at any time.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>Section&nbsp;7. Awards Generally</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">7.1</TD><TD><U>Form&nbsp;and Grant of Awards</U>.&emsp;The Committee shall have the
                                            authority, in its sole discretion, to determine the type or types of Awards to be granted
                                            under the Plan. Subject to the provisions of the Plan (including <U>Section&nbsp;22</U>),
                                            Awards may, in the sole discretion of the Committee, be granted either alone or in addition
                                            to, in tandem with, or in substitution for any other Award or any award granted under any
                                            other plan of the Company or any Affiliate. Awards granted in addition to or in tandem with
                                            other Awards, or in addition to or in tandem with awards granted under any other plan of
                                            the Company or any Affiliate, may be granted either at the same time as or at a different
                                            time from the grant of such other Awards or awards.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>
